welcome.title: Your Mi Band 9 Active, without the cloud
welcome.body: Three quick steps: find the band, paste its key, done. Everything stays on this phone.

points.local: Local first · nothing leaves this phone
points.single: Made only for Mi Band 9 Active

connect.title: Find your band
connect.body: Wake the band and keep it next to your phone.
connect.permissionDenied: Bluetooth permission is needed to find the band.

empty.title: No band found yet
empty.tips:
• Wake the band screen and hold it close
• If Mi Fitness is connected to it, force-stop Mi Fitness (don't unpair — that resets the key)
• Turn on Location services — Android needs it for Bluetooth scans

key.title: Paste the auth key
key.body: Xiaomi bands only talk to apps holding their 32-character auth key. It never leaves this phone.
key.help: Where do I get the key?
key.helpBody: The key is created when the band is bound in Mi Fitness. Gadgetbridge's guide explains how to read it (e.g. with the Huafetcher tool or from a Mi Fitness log).

errors.AUTH_KEY_INVALID: That isn't a valid key — it should be 32 hex characters (0-9, a-f).
errors.AUTH_REJECTED: The band rejected this key. Re-read it from Mi Fitness — unpairing there creates a new key.
errors.BT_OFF: Bluetooth is off. Turn it on and try again.
errors.PERMISSION: Bluetooth permission was revoked. Allow it and try again.
errors.TIMEOUT: The band didn't answer. Keep it close, force-stop Mi Fitness / Gadgetbridge, then retry.
errors.GATT: Bluetooth connection failed. Toggle Bluetooth and retry.

extras.body: Optional — you can change these anytime in Settings.

errors.authFailed: Pairing failed — check the auth key
